description:
Returns financial fundamentals for any US public company from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings: revenue, net income, total assets, stockholders equity, and EPS. Includes both annual (10-K) and quarterly (10-Q) data for the most recent periods. Works for any ticker listed on a US exchange (AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, AMZN, NVDA, GOOGL, META, JPM, BAC, etc.). Source: SEC EDGAR.
Price: $0.75 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, NVDA

name: get_edgar_company
title: Get Company Fundamentals (SEC EDGAR)
